explanation: I searched Mathlib, Batteries and Lean core for forall_or_left/right, or_forall and related names. The only close match is Mathlib's `forall_or_left : (∀ x, q ∨ p x) ↔ q ∨ ∀ x, p x`, whose `.mpr` would give this result. It is circular, though. Its proof goes through `Decidable.forall_or_left`, which calls `forall_or_of_or_forall` (the target theorem) at line 676 of the same file. The core lemmas I found (`forall_or_eq_imp`, `forall_or_imp_or_self_*`, `Grind.forall_or_forall`, `Classical.exists_or_forall_not`) state different results. I did not find an independent declaration.
